name: Yesware
description: Yesware is a sales-engagement platform embedded in Gmail and Outlook for email and attachment tracking, templates, multichannel campaigns, meeting scheduling, contact enrichment, team analytics, and Salesforce synchronization.
agentUseSummary: Yesware documents provider-operated Gmail and Outlook add-ins plus a closed set of end-user integrations, but it does not publish a supported third-party API, OAuth application contract, webhook contract, or automation platform for controlling campaigns or reading a customer workspace. Relay therefore does not capture Yesware, Google, Microsoft, or Salesforce credentials, automate the private add-ins or web application, ingest tracking data, or expose agent actions.

providerSetup.blocker: Yesware does not publish a third-party API, OAuth app distribution contract, webhook contract, or supported automation platform for reading or controlling a customer workspace; its documented connections are provider-operated inbox add-ins and named end-user integrations.
providerSetup.nextAction: Reassess only if Yesware publishes a stable third-party API with explicit authentication, permissions, schemas, distribution terms, revocation, and bounded non-messaging reads suitable for Relay.

evidence.supports: Official documentation describes Gmail and Outlook inbox add-ins for tracking, campaigns, scheduling, presentations, and Salesforce sync, but publishes no third-party developer API or authorization contract.

Official setup documentation requires installation of Yesware's Gmail extension or Outlook add-in and provider-run Google, Microsoft, and optional Salesforce authentication; it also states that Yesware does not integrate with Zapier or Make.

Official integration directory lists provider-operated Gmail, Outlook, Salesforce, LinkedIn, Zoom, Clari, DocSend, and planned Teams integrations, not a public platform for arbitrary third-party workspace access.
Official support explicitly states that Yesware does not currently integrate with Zapier or Make and directs customers only to its supported integration directory.

Official privacy policy describes mailbox/account data, recipient names and email addresses, opens, IP addresses, email subjects and bodies, attachments, presentations, templates, campaigns, and Google API data, reinforcing the decision not to automate private surfaces or ingest tracking data without a supported bounded API.
